text:
jun park: Quick note — I'm prototyping a QuickJump (Cmd/Ctrl+K) + compact sidebar regrouping. Sketch: https://sketch.redwood/quickjump-compact (preview). TL;DR: combine Models + Endpoints into a 'Serving' cluster, add keyboard anchors for primary routes, and surface a persistent breadcrumb bar when you land via deep link. Thoughts on routing and permalink stability?

priya rao: love the cmd+k idea. question: will old permalinks (eg /models/:id) still work after we rename buckets? we get a lot of external links from docs and support tickets.

mike cole: we can keep old slugs working. plan: router middleware does lookup+redirect to new canonical path and we set a 301 for external hits, and a client-side replaceState for single-page nav so back button isn't weird. example mapping: 
```
const legacyMap = {
  '/models/:id': '/workspaces/:wsId/serving/models/:id',
  '/endpoints/:id': '/workspaces/:wsId/serving/endpoints/:id'
}
// middleware: try legacyMap first, then route normally
```

elaine wu: labeling nits — 'Serving' reads a bit abstract to me. Can we try 'Runtime & Endpoints' or 'Serving & Endpoints'? Also microcopy: sidebar collapse control should read 'Hide navigation' (aria-label) not just 'Collapse'. Screen reader expects descriptive text.

samir (sam): +1 on clearer aria-labels. For accessibility: ensure we toggle `aria-expanded` on the collapse button and announce breadcrumb changes with `aria-live="polite"`. If deep link opens a panel, move focus to panel header not the body (so keyboard users know where they are).

jun park: good calls. On canonicalization: we should include a <link rel="canonical"> for SEO and in-app diagnostics. Also preserve hash + query params across redirects. Example edge-case: `/workspaces/123/models/456?tab=metrics#weights` should land at canonical path and keep `?tab=metrics#weights`.

priya rao: analytics ask — tag deep-link entries so we can measure dropoff: add `nav_source=deeplink` and `deeplink_context=external_ticket|doc` to the query string when redirecting (or as a client-side event).

mike cole: infra note: server redirects + client replaceState approach will preserve hash if we rewrite carefully. I'll file an infra ticket for a redirect table and add a small router shim. Will also add a telemetry event on redirect.

elaine wu: design detail — breadcrumbs should show context when you arrive from an external link: show a muted 'Arrived from docs' pill and a small 'Return to workspace' CTA so users can rehydrate context. Also tooltip copy for the grouped sidebar header: use sentence case ("Serving and endpoints") per our a11y guide.

samir (sam): acceptance criteria for sprint: 1) legacy permalinks resolve -> canonical path (hash+query preserved) 2) keyboard QuickJump anchors open correctly and are announced 3) collapse control has descriptive aria label and toggles aria-expanded 4) breadcrumb live region announces path change. I'll own the tests.

jun park: SGTM. I'll update the prototype with the new header copy and add a tiny demo video for PMs. Mike — once you have the redirect table ticket, ping infra on eng-plat.

mike cole: will do. filing now -> https://tickets.redwood/PLAT-3942 : redirect table + router shim + telemetry.

elaine wu: small UX nit: when user arrives via deep link we should not auto-open long side panels (focus trap). Instead show a compact header with a 'Open details' button. That avoids surprising keyboard users.

jun park: agreed. make it a progressive enhancement: compact header default, explicit open to full panel. I'll add that to the prototype notes.

priya rao: thanks — I'll update the docs team so they can keep links stable. Also adding a short copy suggestion for collapse tooltip: "Hide navigation (Cmd/Ctrl+\")" — is that a valid shortcut?

samir (sam): small correction: show shortcut as "Cmd/Ctrl+K" for QuickJump and use the platform-specific label in tooltips.

jun park: ok final checklist for this thread: prototype updated (jun), redirect ticket (mike), a11y acceptance (sam), docs sync (priya). Anything else? :thinking_face:

elaine wu: maybe we should include a tiny migration note in the Console release notes: "Some nav labels grouped for clarity; legacy links remain supported." short + friendly.

mike cole: SGTM. I'll add the redirect table to the release playbook so SRE is aware.

jun park: great — thanks all. I'll post the updated sketch + demo tomorrow and tag folks. :thumbsup:
